For supported Kubernetes versions up to 1.32, EKS will continue to release AL2 AMIs (AL2_ARM_64, AL2_x86_64) and AL2-accelerated AMIs (AL2_x86_64_GPU) until November 26, 2025. After this date, EKS will stop releasing AL2-optimized and AL2-accelerated AMIs for all Kubernetes versions.
